rules.name: rrr-dripping-backup-vs-current-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT lower(trim(contract_number)) AS contract_number, CAST(mtm_post_dripping_today AS numeric(30, 6)) AS mtm_post_dripping_today, CAST(mtm_post_dripping_today_usd AS numeric(30, 6)) AS mtm_post_dripping_today_usd FROM opera_backup_04_10.client_dripping_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu AND value_date = :valueDate

SELECT lower(trim(contract_number)) AS contract_number, CAST(mtm_post_dripping_today AS numeric(30, 6)) AS mtm_post_dripping_today, CAST(mtm_post_dripping_today_usd AS numeric(30, 6)) AS mtm_post_dripping_today_usd FROM opera.client_dripping_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu AND value_date = :valueDate
